images.caption: Figure 1:Noahunderstands, represents, and extends multimodal patient records.(a-e) Patient journey dataset built from MIMIC. (f)Noaharchitecture: multimodal health record events embedded through type category, type specifics, and value. A transformer decoder pretrains on these sequences with causal masking and novel time integration. A novel latent module explicitly learns context-conditional patient states and transitions. (g-h) Autoregressive rollout with optional time control. (i) Outcome simulation for Monte Carlo-style classification and counterfactual analysis. (j) Downstream applications ofNoah’s patient state embeddings.

header: A time-aware model can understand and predict multimodal data over the entire patient journey.

images.caption: Figure 2:Noahlearns patient trajectories as states and transitions.(a-c) All patient states in latent space, mainly organized by contextualized event types. (a) Two exemplar trajectories with similar starting conditions, yet diverging course in embedding space. (d-e) Regions of care levels and risk (time until death). (f-g) Trajectories’ exploration of latent space. (h-n) The model’s surprise at state transitions near stay onsets and across different event types correlates with clinical novelty.
